olivia: Heads-up — after last night's packer refactor (commit a1b2c3) we see ~12% P99 regression on AWQ int8 weight-only path when group_size=128 with KV cache enabled. Throughput dropped from ~420 -> ~370 tok/s on p4d. Logs + perf below. :eyes:
maya: ugh. can you paste the perf/flame? how bad is SLO impact?
olivia: quick numbers: baseline (pre-refactor): 420 tok/s, p99 ~210ms. post-refactor: 370 tok/s, p99 ~235ms. KV cache hit rate 0.80 -> 0.74. CPU sys% up ~6%.
raj: can you share the perf record and which kernel is being chosen now vs before?
olivia: perf capture + stackcollapse commands I used:
```
perf record -F 99 -a -g -- ./serve_bench --model gpt-j-int8 --group-size 128 --kv-cache
perf script | stackcollapse-perf.pl > out.folded
flamegraph.pl out.folded > flame.svg
```
olivia: flame shows a big chunk in `pack_unify()` and `align_copy()` inside packer, plus extra time in mmap/alloc syscalls.
lucas: that matches the pack overlap change — we added an alignment pad step and an extra memcpy for odd group tails in the refactor.
maya: can we try smaller group_size to see sensitivity?
olivia: ran quick variants: group_size=64 -> 410 tok/s, p99 ~218ms. pack_stride=32 -> 415 tok/s. So smaller groups reduce packing overhead significantly.
raj: runtime kernel chooser might be routing more trailing lanes to scalar unpack kernel now. can you dump the route decisions?
olivia: route dump snippet:
``
route: packer -> pack_unify (vector) for full groups
route: packer -> pack_scalar_unroll for trailing groups (len%group_size != 0)
kernel chooser: picked vector kernel 72% vs scalar 28%
```
olivia: note: before refactor vector ~88% and scalar ~12%.
lucas: looks like tail-handling moved earlier in the pipeline, increasing scalar-tail cases. quick fix: raise trailing-group threshold to 8 instead of 1 so small tails still go into vector path.
maya: low-risk hotfix: bump threshold, revert the pad alignment change, and add an early kv-prefetch to lower syscall churn. can you bench after?
olivia: local bench after changes:
- group_size=128 + threshold=8: 418 tok/s, p99 ~212ms, kv hit ~0.79.
- revert pad alignment completely: 420 tok/s (back to baseline).
bench-bot: automated bench run on canary cluster started — job id bench/2401234567-1
bench-bot: results (canary): baseline 421 tok/s, canary (hotfix) 419 tok/s, p99 diff -0.5% (within noise).
maya: plan -> ship hotfix to staging, run multi-hour soak and larger concurrency matrix. also add unit tests for packer tail-case and a perf regression test in CI.
olivia: opened PR #4567 with changelog, perf notes, and bench artifacts. tagging @eng-runtime for rollout review.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-03-18T18:30Z.
lucas: nice catch and solid triage :thumbsup: 
olivia: thanks everyone — will follow up with flame + route diffs in PR.
